_doc: DoD SRG Impact Level 2 (IL2) baseline fragment: DoD public / non-controlled unclassified information. IL2 maps to FedRAMP Moderate (Class C) in the commercial US East/West regions (AWS Services in Scope: 'DoD CSP SRG IL2 (East/West)'). Composed on top of fedramp-moderate; adds the DoD SRG IL2 catalog and CMMC detective coverage. Scaffold until validated with the DoD mission owner / AO.
